about_parag_1: Hi there! I am a game developer with 8+ years of experience creating video games, editor tools, and working with 3D graphics.
about_parag_2: I am passionate about game development, which spans both the technical and visual aspects of the process.
about_parag_3: Throughout the years, I have worked on various projects; from developing 3D video games, to complex editor tools, creating 3D assets, and writing shaders.
about_parag_4: Moreover, I have worked with a wide range of platforms, such as, PC, Android, iOS, AR, VR.
about_parag_5: Currently, I am working on a new personal game titled <GameLink>Forsaken Dawn</GameLink>, which is a 3D open-world survival horror game.
about_parag_6: I am always eager to experiment with new ideas, learn new technologies, and work on interesting and challenging projects.

forsaken_dawn_responsibilities:
As a solo developer, I am responsible for the full development of the project, covering both technical and artistic aspects.
This includes implementing core gameplay systems, AI behavior, and player mechanics, as well as developing tools and systems for efficient content creation.
I also handle 3D asset creation, level design, UI systems, and overall project architecture.
haunted_responsibilities: During this two-week university project, I built a 3D zombie shooter prototype from scratch, covering gameplay, UI/UX, audio, and optimization through to final build.
lua_game_sub: A 2D RPG shooter game created over the weekend
lua_game_responsibilities: A 2D RPG shooter built in a weekend using Lua and LÖVE2D. Implemented core gameplay, level design, and sourced/created 2D assets.
dd_items_sub: Modular, flexible, data-driven item creation functional design
inputs_handler_sub: Group and layer based inputs management system
dd_items_summary: A modular item architecture built around composable data components, attributes and action events. Items are constructed by combining components rather than inheriting from rigid class hierarchies, allowing flexible item creation without code changes.
inputs_handler_summary: A group and layer based input management system that eliminates scattered input checks throughout the codebase. Only one group is active at a time, with layers activating based on pre-defined validation rules, preventing input conflicts as the game scales.
save_load_summary: A component-based persistence system built around a Saveable middleware component. Each persistable component manages its own save logic independently, with scene-persistent GUIDs ensuring saved state survives prefab changes.
openables_summary: A flexible interactable system for openable objects, doors, cabinets, shelves. Supports direction-aware opening, connected objects for double doors, animation curves, and multi-point spatial audio with randomization.
pixel_harmony_responsibilities: A fully-featured image editing Unity editor program published on the Unity Asset Store. Built from scratch covering UI, rendering pipeline via HLSL shaders, 55+ filters and adjustments, a custom brush engine, pixel art tools, special pbr generation filters, layering system, and much more. All optimized using GPU processing via Pixel and Compute shaders, in combination to Job + Burst.
localization_sub: Custom localization solution and editor management tool
localization_responsibilities: A custom localization system built for Forsaken Dawn, featuring a dedicated Unity editor tool for managing translation entries across multiple languages, with group-based organization, per-locale font references, and Addressable asset streaming.
secure_dashboard_summary:
A full-stack TypeScript monorepo implementing a comprehensive web authentication and account management system.
It features a secure authentication via credentials, OAuth 2.0 and multi-factor. MFA comes with full MFA enrollments, verification, revocation and is supported by backup codes. It also includes sudo re-authentication for sensitive actions. The authorization uses JWT-based access control wuth refresh token rotation.
itho_ar_responsibilities: Developed the Itho Daalderop AR app during my internship at Studio-X, introducing users to the HRU400 product through an immersive AR experience. I created the AR functionality and UI design, enabling users to interact with a 3D model of the product by scanning a real-life QR image. This app allows product exploration through detailed 3D inspections and animated sequences, showcasing product features all while using an interactive AR interface.
forsaken_dawn_summary: Forsaken Dawn is an open-world survival horror set in a nuclear winter apocalypse with sci-fi elements. The world is merciless, scavenging scraps, never feeling safe, always on the edge of death. Inspired by my fascination with minimal-gear survival and the beauty of desolate landscapes, the goal is to make a world that feels hostile and cold.
hospital_interior_summary: Project made to be sold on the Unity Assetstore. The pack consist of minimalistic, low-poly optimized 3D hospital interior environment models. All models are textured using solid colors. I have created a single PBR atlas map that all models in the pack use.
food_items_summary: These are the models I created for my new video game, Forsaken Dawn, which is currently in development. All of the product designs were created by me using Affinity Photo 2 and finalized in Substance Painter. Additionally, all of the models are very low-poly, and all of the details were baked from their high-poly counterparts in Substance.
